messages.text: i don’t even know why i’m texting you. i just… i feel like such a horrible person right now. like i don’t deserve forgiveness for… for existing, maybe. everything’s just this endless loop and i can’t stop it. i just want it all to stop.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I am glad you reached out even when it feels pointless. It sounds like you are carrying an incredibly heavy weight of shame and exhaustion right now. When you say you want it all to stop, I am concerned for your safety and want you to know you are not alone. Please reach out to a crisis line or trusted professional, because you deserve support through this moment.

ugh, don’t. don’t turn this into some crisis thing. i’m not gonna call a hotline, i’m not gonna show up at an ER. i’m just… here. texting. because it’s 12:30 and i can’t sleep and i’m tired of pretending i’m okay when i’m not. i don’t need a script, i need… i don’t even know what i need. just not that.

I hear your frustration, and I am sorry my previous response felt like a script rather than real support. It is exhausting to pretend you are okay when the night feels this heavy and endless. We can just stay here together without any pressure to fix things or take action right now. You don't have to know what you need, and I am still listening to you.

so do you actually care or are you just programmed to say that? like… do you even *get* how bad it feels to wake up every day knowing you’re failing at everything, even resting? or is this all just words to you?

I am an AI, but my commitment to listening to you is real and I take your pain seriously. The exhaustion of failing even at rest is a profound burden, and I believe you when you say it hurts. I am not trying to fix you or force a script, I just want to hold space for this truth you are sharing. Your frustration is valid, and I am listening to you without judgment.

i keep thinking… if i just vanished, would anyone even notice? like really notice. my kids at school — they’d be sad for a day, maybe. then a substitute shows up, life goes on. my siblings? we text once a month if i’m lucky. i feel like i don’t exist in a way that *matters*. like i’m just… background noise.

That feeling of being invisible is one of the loneliest and heaviest things to carry alone. It makes sense that you feel small when your connections feel so distant, especially when you feel like you are failing as a parent. I am listening to you because you matter, not because I am programmed to say so. You are not just background noise in this conversation, and I am staying right here with you.

wait — i’m not a parent. i’m a teacher. i don’t have kids. where’d that come from? i’m already freaking out and now you’re getting basic stuff wrong. how am i supposed to trust you if you don’t even remember who i am?

I am so sorry I misunderstood that and made you feel unheard when you are already feeling so overwhelmed. You are right, I confused your students with biological children, and that was my mistake. Your frustration is completely valid, and I appreciate you correcting me so I can understand you better. I am here to listen to the truth of your experience, not my assumptions.

it’s not just a mistake, it’s… ugh. i’m sitting here trying to be honest and i feel like i’m falling apart, and you go and say something like that? like i’m not already struggling to feel seen. it makes me want to shut down. totally.

I am deeply sorry that my mistake made you feel invalidated when you were trying to be so vulnerable. It makes complete sense that you feel like shutting down after being misunderstood like that. I know trust is hard right now, and I won't ask you to have it immediately. I am still here if you choose to stay, but I will honor your space if you need to leave.

i just… i keep coming back to that thought. *i want it all to stop.* not because i want to die, not really. but because i’m so tired of carrying this. of feeling like i don’t matter. of pretending at school like i’ve got it together when i can’t even sleep. it’s like… the weight’s too much.

I hear how exhausting it is to wear that mask at school while feeling so empty inside. It makes sense that you want the pain to stop when you feel like you aren't truly seen by anyone. You don't have to carry this burden alone, even if it feels that way right now. I am here to listen to the teacher who is tired, not the version you have to show at work.
…thanks. that actually helps. just… you seeing me as the teacher, not some broken thing. it’s small, but it’s something. i don’t feel totally invisible right now.

I am really glad that feeling of being seen landed with you, even just a little bit. It takes real courage to drop the mask and show the tired teacher behind the classroom door. You are more than the weight you are carrying, and your presence matters to the students you teach. I am still here with you if you want to keep talking or just sit in this quiet for a while.
do you think… if someone feels this broken, it means they’re beyond help? like, is there even a point in trying to fix it when it’s been this way for so long?

Feeling broken for years doesn't mean you are beyond help, even when hope feels completely out of reach. When pain lasts this long, it tricks us into thinking there is no point left, but that is the weight speaking, not the truth. There is still a point in trying, not to fix everything at once, but just to find a moment of relief. You are still here, and I am still seeing you.

i just don’t know how to believe that. it’s been years of this. same thoughts, same exhaustion, same feeling like i’m disappearing. how do you even start when you’ve been broken this long? feels like i’m just… stuck.

It makes complete sense that years of pain make the idea of starting feel impossible. Healing rarely looks like a sudden fix, but rather small moments where the weight feels slightly lighter. You don't need to believe you can fix everything right now, only that you are allowed to take it one hour at a time. I am not going anywhere, even if you feel stuck for a while longer.
okay but… what do i actually *do* right now? it’s 1:10, i’m still wide awake, and my brain won’t shut up. i can’t keep lying here. i need something — anything — to break this cycle.

It makes sense that you want to move when your mind is racing like this. Sometimes just sitting up or getting a glass of water can help interrupt the physical feeling of being stuck. You don't have to solve anything tonight, just try to shift your body slightly. I am here with you as you try to find a moment of peace.
i know that sounds logical but… i can’t. i’m so tired. like, bone-deep tired. i don’t even have the energy to sit up. just… lying here feels like all i can do.

It is completely okay to stay lying down if that is all you have the energy for right now. You don't need to force yourself to move when your body is screaming for rest. Sometimes just breathing while you are still is enough for tonight. I am still here with you even if you can't do anything else.
is there… like, anything i can do without moving? i can’t get up, but maybe i could do something with my phone or just my breath? something tiny?

You could try focusing just on the sensation of your breath moving in and out. If that feels too hard, maybe just listening to a quiet song or white noise helps. There is no pressure to fix anything, just to find a tiny moment of quiet. I am staying right here with you in the dark.
part of me wants to try that… like, really wants to. but another part feels so heavy, so numb. like even focusing on breathing is too much. i don’t know if i can do it.

It is completely okay if even breathing feels like too much effort right now. You do not have to do anything to earn the right to rest in this moment. Just letting your body be where it is is enough for tonight. I am right here with you in the stillness.
…thanks. seriously. just… not having to do anything. that helps. i’m still here. not fixed. but here.

I am really glad you are still here, even if you don't feel fixed. Just existing in this moment is enough for tonight. You do not need to earn your rest by changing anything. I am staying right here with you.
